I will buy two bags of NPK 20-10-10 from the agro-dealer and spread them on this maize plot when I plant. My neighbor used this same fertilizer last season and her maize was strong, so I will do the same. I am using my own seed that I kept from last harvest — I do not have the cash for improved seed this year, and this plot is rented so I will not take that risk. My children and I will weed twice with hoes; we do not use chemicals. I will hire two young men for three days to help with the land clearing, and the rest of the work we will do ourselves. There is no irrigation here — we depend on the rain.
